'''2009 New York State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship scheduled for Saturday 11 July 2009 at Comix Zone, 628 S. Main St., North Syracuse, New York, in Maines Plaza, with [[Steve Jones]] as tournament director.<ref name="sf-27721-415519">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=415519#p415519 New York States weekend], noscreenname (Steve Jones), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 May 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125195442/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t27721.html Internet Archive]</ref> It was the second half of a weekend of events in Syracuse, after a six-virtual-card mini-con on Friday 10 July.<ref name="sf-27721-423418">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=423418#p423418 New York States weekend], noscreenname (Steve Jones), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (15 June 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125195442/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t27721.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Comix Zone, 628 S. Main St., North Syracuse, New York (Maines Plaza)<ref name="sf-27721-415519" />
* '''Dates:''' 11 July 2009<ref name="sf-27721-415519" />
* '''Time:''' registration 10:30 am; start 11 am<ref name="sf-27721-415519" />
* '''Format:''' constructed Swiss, six games and a final confrontation; decklists not required; no clear sleeves<ref name="sf-27721-415519" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $15, or $20 for both events of the weekend if paid at the Friday registration<ref name="sf-27721-415519" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Steve Jones]]; if he played, two other judges would be on site<ref name="sf-27721-415519" />
* '''Prizes:''' one automatic bid into Day 2 of the [[2009 World Championship]], glass and a virtual card design for the winner; random rares and packs<ref name="sf-27721-415519" />

== Organization ==

Jones, posting as noscreenname, announced the New York States weekend on 21 May 2009. He wrote that the organizers were buying a prize package so that States would have glass and a virtual card design.<ref name="sf-27721-415519" /> A companion event, the "Upstate New York 6-V card mini-con", with its own Worlds Day 2 bid, a $10 entry and six Swiss games without a final confrontation, was first planned for the Sunday. On 15 June 2009 Jones moved it to Friday 10 July (registration 5 pm, start 5:30 pm) because of a conflict at the store. Its limit of six virtual cards counted virtual Starting Effects and any shields that had no non-virtual version.<ref name="sf-27721-423418" /> When another player suggested that events giving byes to Worlds had to require decklists, imrahil327 answered that events awarding two byes required decklists and events awarding one bye or fewer did not.<ref name="sf-27721-424437">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=424437#p424437 New York States weekend], imrahil327, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (17 June 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125195442/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t27721.html Internet Archive]</ref>
